newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Shi'ite Moslem activist shot dead in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Shi'ite Moslem activist shot dead in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen killed a Shi'ite Moslem activist in the Pakistani city of Lahore on Friday in what police said might have been a sectarian murder.
They said Ghulam Mustafa Jafri, a lawyer, was shot in the head as he was returning home on a motorcyle after taking his children to school. No other details were immediately available.
Armed Sunni and Shi'ite Moslem militants are locked in a long-running feud, particularly in the populous province of Punjab, of which Lahore is the capital.
